learning_anchors.label: Introductory / Declarative
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Syntax-level understanding of tensor packages, matrix notation, and machine learning concepts self-teachable in under 15 hours.
typical_signals: Reads documentation tutorials for PyTorch or scikit-learn without debugging
Identifies basic layer types and standard mathematical loss functions

learning_anchors.label: Foundational Practical
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Foundational tensor mathematics, automatic differentiation, training loops, and evaluation mechanics mastered in 15 to 40 hours with programming foundations.
typical_signals: Constructs clean PyTorch training loops with forward and backward passes
Logs model artifacts and evaluation metrics to versioned registries

learning_anchors.label: Intermediate Systemic
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Deep neural architectures, attention projections, parameter-efficient adapters, and uncertainty calibration demanding 25 to 65 hours.
typical_signals: Implements multi-head attention and causal masking from scratch
Calibrates conformal prediction intervals with distribution-free coverage

learning_anchors.label: Advanced Methodological / Architectural
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Distributed parallel sharding, direct preference optimization mathematics, low-bit quantization, and differential privacy foundations (40 to 90 hours).
typical_signals: Implements tensor-parallel sharding across multi-GPU compute topologies
Derives closed-form implicit reward gradients for preference alignment

learning_anchors.label: Expert Frontier
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Custom hardware kernel optimization, novel foundational model architectures, and formal algorithmic verification (>90 hours).
typical_signals: Writes custom fused Triton/CUDA kernels for attention operations
Develops novel optimization formulations with theoretical convergence bounds

application_anchors.label: Isolated Templated
application_anchors.anchor_description: Execution within clean sandbox environments against scripted tutorial datasets.
typical_signals: Runs standard training notebooks on benchmark datasets cleanly
Implements boilerplate classification pipelines matching established patterns

application_anchors.label: Guided Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Applied to standardized training pipelines with established tracking, CI, and tests.
typical_signals: Integrates model training scripts with automated artifact versioning
Audits training and validation splits against accidental data leakage

application_anchors.label: Unconstrained Real-World
application_anchors.anchor_description: Navigates noisy data distributions, gradient instabilities, and VRAM memory bounds.
typical_signals: Diagnoses vanishing gradients and configures adaptive learning rate schedules
Fine-tunes transformer models on custom domain datasets without overfitting

application_anchors.label: High-Stakes Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Mission-critical deployment where faults degrade throughput, leak private data, or generate unconstrained completions.
typical_signals: Architects low-latency quantized serving clusters with strict SLAs
Enforces verifiable machine unlearning complying with DPDP Act Sec 12

application_anchors.label: Strategic Enterprise Architecture
application_anchors.anchor_description: Organizational-level AI infrastructure involving multi-node training clusters, fault-tolerant checkpoint resumption, and enterprise alignment.
typical_signals: Orchestrates 100+ GPU distributed cluster runs with zero communication deadlocks
Establishes organization-wide model governance, calibration, and red-teaming
